cohort: The study included 327 pregnant women who underwent first-trimester aneuploidy screening at 11-13+6 weeks' gestation.
finding: The combination of uterine artery PI and serum HRG level at 11-13+6 weeks of gestation was not an effective method for predicting preeclampsia at the time of first-trimester screening.
followup_time: Until delivery (implied, as preeclampsia, preterm delivery, and IUGR are recorded outcomes)
gest_age: Exposure measured at 11-13+6 weeks' gestation; preterm delivery was an outcome, implying various gestational ages at birth.
